enableAgricultureHelp: Solar radiation, CAPE, soil temperature, irradiance under *.agriculture
enableComfortHelp: Heat index, wind chill, humidex, UV index under *.comfort
hourlyDaysExceedsDaysCount: Must not exceed number of forecast days
hourlyDaysHighWarning: Each hourly day generates many datapoints depending on enabled options
iconSetCustomHint:
Upload to: Admin → Files → openmeteo-notify.0/icons/custom/
Required day icons (24):
wmo_00  wmo_01  wmo_02  wmo_03  wmo_45  wmo_48
wmo_51  wmo_53  wmo_55  wmo_61  wmo_63  wmo_65
wmo_71  wmo_73  wmo_75  wmo_77  wmo_80  wmo_81
wmo_82  wmo_85  wmo_86  wmo_95  wmo_96  wmo_99
Night icons optional (suffix n): wmo_00n.svg, wmo_01n.svg …

Note: custom icons are embedded as Base64 in the widget datapoint (each icon only once) and enlarge it accordingly.
Please use small, pure vector SVGs where possible (a few KB per icon). If your SVGs contain embedded
pixel images, choose the lowest resolution possible. The built-in icon sets are not embedded.
warnOfficialMinLevelHelp: Only send notification from this warning level onwards
warnLevelDesc1: All warnings – including preliminary information and notices
warnLevelDesc2: Standard warnings and above – e.g. frost, wind, slippery roads
warnLevelDesc3: Severe warnings and above – e.g. storm, heavy rain, severe weather
warnLevelDesc4: Extreme warnings only – highest danger level
warnExcludeKeywordsHelp: Comma-separated keywords – warnings containing any of these will not trigger a notification
warnExcludeDisplay: Also hide excluded warnings in widgets and screensaver
warnExcludeDisplayHelp: Warnings containing an exclude keyword are then left out of the widgets' warning badge and the screensaver. They stay in the datapoints.
warnIntervalMinutesHelp: How often DWD / MeteoAlarm is queried – independent of the weather update interval
widgetDetailedNoAstronomy: Astronomy data is disabled – moon phases will not be shown in the detailed widget. Enable Astronomy in General settings.
widgetDetailedNoHourly: Hourly data is disabled – the detailed widget will show no hourly section. Enable hourly days in General settings.
widgetDetailedPartialHourly: Hourly data is only available for %s day(s) – remaining days show daily data only. Increase hourly days in General settings to cover more days.
warnNotifyLiftHelp: Sends a notification when a previously reported warning is cancelled or expires
widgetHint: Each widget creates an HTML datapoint that can be embedded directly in VIS, Jarvis or similar.
enableWarnOfficialFetchNotifyHint: To also receive push notifications for official warnings, enable them in the Notifications tab.
widgetShowWarnBadgeHint: Enable official warnings under General → Optional data to use the badge.
warnOfficialEnableFetchHint: To use the widget warning badge, also enable official warnings under General → Optional data.
enableWarnOfficialFetchHelp: Fetches official warning data and creates data points — required for the widget warning badge.
validationBadgeNeedsWarnData: Warning badge is enabled but official warnings are not active (enable under General or Notifications).
warningsOpenMeteoHint: Warnings look as far ahead as hourly data is fetched.
notificationManagerMissingHint: Notifications are sent via the ioBroker notification system. To receive messages (e.g. via Telegram, Signal or email), the "notification-manager" adapter must be installed and configured.
notificationManagerNotRunningHint: The 'notification-manager' adapter is installed but not currently running. Start it in the adapter settings to enable notification delivery.
notificationManagerFoundHint: The 'notification-manager' adapter is installed. Go to its settings to configure notification channels (e.g. Telegram, email). The settings on this page only affect openmeteo-notify.
hourlyDaysHelp: For how many days hourly values should be stored (must be ≤ number of days)
iconSetHelp: Which icon set to use for the icon_url datapoint
warnFrostThresholdHelp: Send warning when temperature drops below this value
warnLeadHoursHelp: How many hours in advance to warn (1–24)
warnNeedsHourlyInterval: Hourly warnings require an update interval of 60 minutes.
warnOfficialHelp: Receive push notifications for official weather warnings
widgetOptionsGreyed: Greyed-out options indicate that a value in General settings needs to be increased.
wallpaperHint: Configure the animated WMO weather wallpaper generated per location - see current.wallpaper_url_<instance>.
wallpaperNoFieldsWarning: No fields are enabled - the overlay will be empty.
wallpaperBgPhotoHint: The background photo lives at Admin → Files → <instance>/wallpapers/<location>.jpg - a default photo is created automatically, replace it by uploading your own file with the same name.
wallpaperWarnEnabled: Show active warnings as text banner
wallpaperCarouselEnabled: Show left/right arrows to browse between locations
liveUpdateMinutes: Live update interval (minutes, current conditions only)
liveUpdateMinutesHelp: 0 = disabled. Refreshes only current.* and the Wallpaper more often than the full forecast update, without re-fetching the whole daily/hourly forecast.
wallpaperPreviewWarning: Official warning of severe storm gusts (Beaufort 9)
wallpaperOverlapHint: Same corner as the info display - they will overlap.
minutelyHelp: Fetches values in 15-minute steps for the next 1–4 hours (precipitation, rain, showers, snow, probability, temperature, gusts) under <location>.minutely plus rain_starts_in and rain_ends_at. Separate small request with its own interval.
minutelyNotifyHelp: Notifies once per precipitation spell when precipitation above the threshold starts within the lead time. No notification if it is already raining.
widgetNowcastNoMinutely: Only shown when the 15-minute forecast is enabled in the settings.
messengersIntro: Weather warnings and the other notifications of this adapter can go to the ioBroker notification system, directly to messengers such as Telegram or e-mail – or to both.
notifyManagerHelp: As before: the notifications appear in the admin and the notification manager adapter forwards them to the messengers set up there. Switch it off if you only want the messengers below.
messengersHelp: Each row gets every notification directly, in the messenger's own format. Only messengers this adapter knows and that are installed can be chosen; the fields each one needs appear next to it. Other messengers can be reached via the notification system above.
messengersTestSent: Test message sent to %s messenger(s) – please check whether it arrived.
messengersNoneHint: The notification system is switched off and no messenger is active – no notifications are sent.
mh_telegram: Empty = every user who talked to the bot. Otherwise the user's name or a chat ID (e.g. of a group).
mh_email: Empty = recipient from the e-mail adapter settings; separate several addresses with commas.
mh_pushover: Empty = all devices. Warnings come with high priority.
mh_pushsafer: Empty = all devices. Warnings come with the highest priority.
mh_gotify: Nothing to fill in – the token from the Gotify settings is used. Warnings come with priority 8.
mh_whatsapp-cmb: Format +491701234567. Empty = the number from the adapter settings.
mh_signal-cmb: Format +491701234567. Empty = the number from the adapter settings.
mh_gsmsms: Required, format +491701234567. The SMS is sent by the GSM modem.
mh_discord: One of the two: a user for a direct message or a channel as server ID/channel ID, e.g. 813364154118963251/813364154559102998.
mh_max: Empty = every user the bot knows.
mh_iot: Message to the ioBroker Visu app. Empty = all phones, otherwise the device names from the app separated by commas. Warnings come with high priority.
mh_synochat: Required: the channel name as in the synochat settings (channel of type 'incoming').
messengerUnsupported: No longer supported directly – please use it via the notification system or delete the row.
messengerNotInstalled: This instance is not installed (any more).
messengersNoneInstalled: No supported messenger installed. Supported are Telegram, e-mail, Pushover, Pushsafer, Gotify, WhatsApp and Signal (CallMeBot), SMS (gsmsms, seven.io), Discord, MAX, the ioBroker Visu app (iot) and Synology Chat.
messengersNeedRunning: The list of installed messengers appears when the instance is running.
mh_sevenio: Required: number like +491701234567 or a contact name from seven.io. The SMS is sent via seven.io.
